correctness.rationale: Affine normalization maps regular pentagon vertices z+ρq_j in E_{a,b} to a common translated cloud (ρ/b)(sqrt(x)cosθ_j,sinθ_j). Feasibility iff ρ/b times five-point minimum-enclosing-circle radius ≤1. Three fixed vertices bound this radius below by a triangle minimum enclosing circle; squared circumradius is proportional to a cubic P(y), with Pʺ(y)=2m d²(1−2h)−6d³ y<0 on y∈[h,1], so no interior acute-orientation optimizer. When triangle obtuse, its longest-edge half-diameter decreases to right-angle boundary, controlling that regime. Explicit endpoint disk certificates have four contacts at major-axis orientation if x≥1/sqrt(5), and three at minor-axis orientation for x>0. Factorization of U²−V² yields sole transition x*≈0.49557283946 above 1/sqrt(5), with endpoints feasible and intermediate orientations excluded. Direct derivative signs prove strictly increasing scale-free optimal area ratio. Independent 248 pair/triple MEC configurations across eight anisotropies corroborated the exact formulas and phase placement.
